stations.title: Sunniva
stations.say: Why is it twelve places again?

stations.title: The API
stations.text: Keeps workshops in memory, from the code.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: No file to keep them in

captions: At the front desk, Sunniva took the family morning up to fourteen places on Monday.
The API keeps workshops in memory, so last night's restart put twelve back.
You make a table in a database file, fill it once, and open it on every start.
The family morning keeps its fourteen places in kilnworth.db, restart or not.
The workshops now have a file to live in, and the next issues move the API onto it.
